snippet.title: Infinite Alliance - Indie Crossover Reveal Trailer (Chained Echoes, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Quartet)
snippet.description:
Heroes and villains from 13+ Indie JRPGs collide, in this story rich Crossover Event! 
Wishlist on Steam for updates: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720330/Infinite_Alliance/

Chained Echoes, Jack Move, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, Quartet, and more unite for a totally FREE adventure!

Pulled from their homes and stranded on a dead world, a disparate group of champions must face their past, redeem a failed hero, and slay a dark force which threatens all creation... 

Engage in stylish turn-based battles with a party of 9 unique heroes, and encounter familiar friends, foes, and environments re-imagined. 

Infinite Alliance showcases the creative variety of the Indie JRPG scene, and we hope you'll discover your next favorite game through this free collaboration - launching in 2026!

Heroes
- Glenn from Chained Echoes
- The Warrior (named by the player) from 8-Bit Adventures 2
- Noa from Jack Move
- Whoopis from My Familiar
- Vera and Arin from Eternal Remnant
- Alexandra from Quartet
- Rio from Shrine’s Legacy
- Dustin from Kingdoms of the Dump
- Chel from For a Vast Future 
- Gio from Geo Mythica 

Villains
- Drago from Beloved Rapture
- Montam from Venaitura
- The Fateshifter from Ephemeral Tale
- Qliphoth - an original villain.

And more to be announced...

#jrpg #rpg #pixelart #indiegameOfficial
